title: Quantum Backflow Bounds with External Potentials
exact_target: Does quantum backflow remain bounded when a particle scatters through an external potential?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30003582 (OWR-15584-003). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Mathematical Questions and Challenges in Quantum Electrodynamics and its Applications (2017), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2017/41, pp. 2539--2599. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 51, 52, 53.
Bostelmann--Cadamuro--Lechner (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).
Cadamuro (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The potential class, smearing function and scattering-wave-operator assumptions are essential and must follow the report. Positivity of incoming momentum does not mean the interacting state has positive momentum support at every time.
